steps.say: A fraction is equal parts of a whole.

figure.alt: A circle cut into 3 equal parts with 1 part shaded.

steps.say: The bottom number is how many equal parts. The top number is how many we take.
2 quarters are the same as 1 half.

figure.alt: A bar cut into 4 equal parts with 2 parts shaded.

steps.say: Three quarters is 3 of 4 equal parts.

figure.alt: A square cut into 4 equal parts with 3 parts shaded.

check.prompt: What fraction of the shape is shaded?

figure.alt: A circle cut into 4 equal parts with 1 part shaded.

hints: Count all the equal parts. That is the bottom number.
Count the shaded parts. That is the top number.
check.explanation: 1 of 4 equal parts is shaded, so 1/4 is shaded.

options.why: 1/3 means 1 of 3 equal parts. This shape has 4 parts.
3 parts are white. Count the shaded parts.
1/2 means 1 of 2 equal parts. This shape has 4 parts.

check.prompt: How many thirds make one whole?

figure.alt: A bar cut into 3 equal parts with 3 parts shaded.

hints: A third is one of three equal parts.
Look at a shape cut into thirds.
Count the parts in the whole shape.
check.explanation: A whole cut into thirds has 3 equal parts.
